data.name: Prithvina
data.gender_notes: Prithvina is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prithvi is the Hindu goddess of the earth. 'Prithvina' is a feminine name derived from 'Prithvi'. It is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing the strength, stability, and nurturing power of Mother Earth. The name Prithvina carries the meaning “Lord of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Prithvina usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Connects the bearer to the earth and the divine.
data.etymology: Prithvina belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prithvina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Prithvina' is deeply rooted in Hindu culture, paying homage to the divine goddess of the earth, Prithvi. It carries the meaning of 'one who belongs to the earth' or 'daughter of the earth'. Thus, this name promotes a connection with nature and reverence for the earth and its abundant resources.
data.spiritual_significance: 'Prithvina' embodies the spiritual essence of groundedness, stability, and the cyclical nature of creation and destruction. It signifies an individual's connection to the Earth as the source of life and nurturing force. By adopting this name, one can seek the blessings of Prithvi Devi to lead a life in harmony with nature and the divine energies that sustain it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Prithvi means Earth in Sanskrit. The name Prithvina signifies a deep connection and reverence for the Earth and all its living beings. It is a reminder to live in harmony with nature and respect the divine energy that sustains us.

vedic_reference.note: The name Prithvina is not directly derived from any Vedic root or mythology.

historical_references.reference: Prithiviraj Chauhan, also known as Prithvi Raj III, was a Hindu ruler of the Chauhan dynasty in the 12th century. He is best known for his resistance against the invading Muslim armies led by Muhammad Ghori.

Prithvi Narayan Sahu II was a king of the Sahu dynasty of Odisha, who ruled from 1793 to 1811. He is known for his efforts to expand the kingdom and strengthen its defenses, as well as his patronage of art and culture.
